title: Play at duration while ended replays (aac-48khz)
product-requirement: Client must anticipate standard MSE replay behaviour when playing at duration while MediaSource is in the ended state.
specification: Terminals MUST implement Media Source Extensions API (https://www.w3.org/TR/media-source-2/).
assertion: Media replays from the start. MediaSource and MediaElement events must emit in expected order, and properties must be of expected values.

changelog.summary: Fixed race condition: slow segment download speed can cause timeouts
